_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley Dialogue-rainy.xnb strings, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Japanese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence). Each entry: "japanese" (exact source text), "english" (a natural-ish literal translation, for context), and "segments" -- an ordered array of {text, reading, gloss} whose "text" fields concatenate back to exactly reproduce "japanese" (validated by tools/segment-data/segtool.py).

Abigail.japanese: 雨の日って、 風景が より 興味深く 見えるね… あなたは どう思う？
Abigail.english: On rainy days, the scenery looks more interesting, doesn't it... What do you think?

Alex.japanese: ふん…こういう 天気じゃ 運動できねえな。$s#$e#まあ、 家の中で いつでも 筋トレできる けどな。$h
Alex.english: Hmph... In weather like this I can't do sports. Well, I can always do strength training inside the house though.

Caroline.japanese: うちの 庭にとって 良い日ね。$h#$e#…それに、 今月の 水道代も 安く済むし。
Caroline.english: It's a good day for our garden. And besides, this month's water bill will be cheap too.

Clint.japanese: 今日は 鉱山を 探索するには いい日 かもな…そこで、 珍しい 鉱石が 見つかる時も あるぞ。
Clint.english: Today might be a good day to explore the mine... there, sometimes rare ores are found.

Demetrius.japanese: こんにちは。寒い思いを したくなかったら、 中に いても いいよ。
Demetrius.english: Hello. If you don't want to feel cold, you can stay inside.

segments.gloss: if you don't want to do

Dwarf.japanese: 雨…オレ達にとっては 伝説 みたいな ものさ。一度も 雨を 見ることなく 生涯を 終える ドワーフだって いるからな。
Dwarf.english: Rain... For us it's like a legend. There are even dwarves who end their lives without ever seeing rain.

Elliott.japanese: ベッドに 横たわっていると、 時々 霧笛の音が 雨越しに 聞こえるんだ。#$b#窓を 開けて 外を 見ても、 灰色の カーテンしか 見えないけどね。
Elliott.english: When I lie in bed, sometimes I can hear the sound of a foghorn through the rain. Even if I open the window and look outside, I can only see a gray curtain, though.

Emily.japanese: カリコ砂漠では 雨は 振らないの…友達の サンディは そこに 住んでるの。#$e#今日は 彼女に 会いに いけたらなぁ。$s
Emily.english: It doesn't rain in the Calico Desert... My friend Sandy lives there. I wish I could go see her today.

Evelyn.japanese: 起きた時、 水の落ちる音が 聞こえたのよ…屋根から 雨漏り してるのかしらね。$s#$e#昔は、 ジョージが すぐに 登って 直しにいってたけど… はぁ…$s
Evelyn.english: When I woke up, I heard the sound of water dripping... I wonder if the roof is leaking. In the old days, George would go right up and fix it... *sigh*

George.japanese: えらく 寒いとは 思わんかね？サイアクの日じゃ。
George.english: Don't you think it's terribly cold? It's the worst day.

Gus.japanese: こういう日は 辛口の 赤ワインを 飲むのが 一番だ。#$e#これだから バーテンダーは 最高さ。へへっ。
Gus.english: On a day like this, drinking dry red wine is the best. That's why being a bartender is the best. Heheh.

Haley.japanese: 朝は ずっと 髪のセットを してたけど… 雨じゃ 台無しに なっちゃうわ。$s#$e#はぁ…人生って つらい時が あるのね。
Haley.english: I was doing my hair all morning, but... in the rain it'll be ruined. *sigh* ... life has hard times sometimes.

Harvey.japanese: あら、@！えっと…最近、 図書館で これという 面白い 本を 読みましたか？#$e#うん。えっと、あー…また 後で 会いましょう。
Harvey.english: Oh, @! Um... Have you read any particularly interesting books at the library lately? Yeah. Um, ah... let's meet again later.

Jodi.japanese: あがる前に 靴は ふいたかしら？ごめんなさいね…床掃除を した ばかりなのよ。#$e#でも、 あなたなら いつでも 歓迎よ！フフッ。$h
Jodi.english: Did you wipe your shoes before coming up? I'm sorry... I just cleaned the floor. But you're always welcome! Heheh.

Krobus.japanese: 今日は 下水道の 流れが 速いですね。いい感じに 潤ってきますね…いい塩梅 ですよ。
Krobus.english: Today the sewer flow is fast. It's getting nicely moist... just the right amount.

Leah.japanese: 今日は 何か 新しい 料理に 挑戦 してみようかしら。スパイシーな やつをね。
Leah.english: Maybe today I'll try challenging myself with some new cooking. Something spicy.

Leo.japanese: 雨が降ると、谷が穏やかになるんだよ。#$e#ボクにとって…自然は色んな感情を持った、身近な友達なんだ。
Leo.english: When it rains, the valley becomes calm. To me... nature is a close friend with all kinds of feelings.

Lewis.japanese: やぁ、@！今日は 休みかね？#$e#川が 溢れなきゃ いいんじゃが…$s
Lewis.english: Hey, @! Are you off today? I hope the river doesn't overflow...

Linus.japanese: 暖かい雨は、 汚れを おとすのに いいな。$h
Linus.english: Warm rain is good for washing off dirt.

Marnie.japanese: @さんこんにちは。かわいそうに…あなた、 ずぶぬれ じゃない！$h
Marnie.english: Hello, @. Poor thing... you're soaked, aren't you!

Maru.japanese: 雨って、 一日中 ガジェットつくりに 没頭する いい 理由に なるのよね。$h#$e#あなたにとっては 退屈 でしょうけど。
Maru.english: Rain is a good reason for me to be absorbed in making gadgets all day. Though it must be boring for you.

Pam.japanese: あら。濡れないように してるのかい？
Pam.english: Oh. Are you trying not to get wet?

segments.gloss: so as not to get wet

Penny.japanese: トレーラーハウスの 金属の屋根じゃ、 雨音が とても うるさいのよ。#$e#… 心地よい 音だけど。$h
Penny.english: On the metal roof of the trailer house, the sound of rain is very loud. ...though it's a pleasant sound.

Pierre.japanese: こんな日は みんな 家から 出なくなりますね…商売 あがったりですよ。$s
Pierre.english: On a day like this, everyone stops leaving their house... business is bad.

Robin.japanese: 雨ぐらいで 仕事の 手を 止めるわけには いかないわ！$h#$e#木材が 湿って 作業が はかどらなくなるけど。$s
Robin.english: I can't let a little rain stop my work! Though the wood gets damp and makes the work not go well.

Sam.japanese: 雨の おかげで、 オフクロに しかられずに ギターの 練習が できるぜ。へへっ。$h
Sam.english: Thanks to the rain, I can practice guitar without my mom scolding me. Heheh.

Sandy.japanese: あっちじゃ 雨が 振ってるって 聞いたわ。だから 砂漠へ きたの？$h#$e#実は私、 雨が 恋しかったりするのよ…$s
Sandy.english: I heard it's raining over there. Is that why you came to the desert? Actually, I kind of miss the rain...

Sebastian.japanese: 運が良かったら、 雨の日には カエルが 見れるかもな。
Sebastian.english: If you're lucky, you might be able to see a frog on a rainy day.

Shane.japanese: ふん… こんな季節は 飲みたくなるな。$s
Shane.english: Hmph... This kind of season makes me want to drink.

Wizard.japanese: 嵐の日は、 特定の 元素と 交信することが できる 唯一の 時期じゃ。#$e#貴殿には 理解 できるとは 思えぬがな。
Wizard.english: Stormy days are the only time I can commune with certain elements. Though I doubt you could understand.
